parallels.note: David was afraid of Yahweh that day; and he said, “How could Yahweh’s ark come to me?”

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”
translations.bsb: That day David feared God and asked, “How can I ever bring the ark of God to me?”
translations.kjv: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?
